extra.axes_note: TWO INDEPENDENT AXES, only one of which the level name states. `_ss` = the far-field clamp h_far=min(2.5,120*h_wall) is OFF (self-similar) and says NOTHING about the tip. `_flat` = flat tip cap; ABSENCE of `_flat` = ROUND, but only since 2026-08-04 -- before that date the same name meant FLAT, and that silent flip is the 2.0 % that stood five days (phase 3 round 36, F-MESH). h_far_over_h_wall == 120 means the clamp did not bite, i.e. this level IS on the refinement ray. Source: each generator's own LEVELS table, read at stamping time.
extra.note: R3 CLOSED 2026-08-18 (GS4.0): byte-identical to its partner BY CONSTRUCTION, not by a directory copy. onera_m6 clamps h_far=min(2.5,120*h_wall) so that coarse/medium/fine stay bit-identical for the P5/G8.2/B7/M1 locks, and defines RICHARDSON_LADDER=(xcoarse_ss,coarse_ss,medium) with the clamp OFF; onera_m6_roundtip is unclamped from the start and its own comment says 'its coarse is what the shipped onera_m6 family needs a coarse_ss for'. Since 2026-08-04 both use tip_cap=round for non-_flat levels. => same construction, same parameters, same bytes. No cross-family risk existed in phase 3's S-ladder.
